leadIn: After completing this lesson, you will be able to:
objectives: Implement a memoization function that caches computed results
Construct a cache object with size tracking and key-value storage
Configure cache eviction logic when the size limit is exceeded
Integrate argument serialization to generate consistent cache keys
Manipulate cache entries to maintain the most recently used items
Initialize the memoization utility with configurable size limits
Apply the memoized function to optimize repeated calculations
lessonTitle: Build memoization utility with cache size limit
